{
  "name": "gmail-mcp-server",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "MCP Server for Gmail operations with Scalekit OAuth authentication and tool calling",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "dist/server.js",
  "bin": {
    "gmail-mcp-server": "./dist/server.js"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc && chmod +x dist/server.js",
    "start": "node dist/server.js",
    "dev": "tsx src/server.ts",
    "watch": "tsx watch src/server.ts",
    "clean": "rm -rf dist",
    "rebuild": "npm run clean && npm run build",
    "test": "echo \"No tests yet\" && exit 0"
  },
  "keywords": [
    "mcp",
    "model-context-protocol",
    "gmail",
    "scalekit",
    "oauth2",
    "authentication",
    "meetstream"
  ],
  "author": "",
  "license": "MIT",
  "dependencies": {
    "@modelcontextprotocol/sdk": "^1.0.4",
    "@scalekit-sdk/node": "^2.0.0",
    "dotenv": "^16.4.5",
    "express": "^4.18.2",
    "cors": "^2.8.5",
    "helmet": "^7.1.0",
    "winston": "^3.11.0",
    "zod": "^3.23.8"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^22.10.2",
    "@types/express": "^4.17.21",
    "@types/cors": "^2.8.17",
    "typescript": "^5.7.2",
    "tsx": "^4.19.2"
  },
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=18.0.0"
  }
}
